result.rationale: Small intact friction blister on the heel in a healthy 32-year-old with no signs of infection (no redness, pus, fever) and no functional impairment; requesting general protection advice only. Appropriate for self-care: leave blister intact, cover with a protective bandage or blister pad, avoid the offending shoes, keep clean; seek clinician review if redness, pus, increasing pain, fever, or spreading develops.
